inputs: target books per decision instant, kind-tagged DISCRETIONARY vs FORCED_FLAT
declared CostModel (taker fee bps, adverse tick floor, tick sizes)

hard_constraint.rule: the gate must not compute or expose scored outcome series of any candidate
hard_constraint.enforcement: outcome_blind_attestation block in every payload; test_no_report_key_contains_a_scored_outcome_token walks every emitted key
hard_constraint.emits: counts, durations, traded-notional fractions and cost drags only

fail_closed.rule: missing inputs -> metric UNAVAILABLE -> verdict UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED; never an inferred PASS
fail_closed.structural: missing decision book / unknown kind / non-finite weight / non-monotonic instants raise ContractViolation

floors_frozen.definition: scheduled discretionary rebalance decisions normalised to a 365-day equivalent window must not exceed 60
median completed intended holding span (calendar days, from target-book occupancy) must be at least 3
annualised transition cost at the declared cost floor, divided by average gross capital, must not exceed 0.08
annualised transition cost under fee x1.5 and +2 adverse ticks, divided by average gross capital, must not exceed 0.12
no single symbol may contribute more than 25% of total one-way turnover (sum of absolute target deltas)

stress_definition.baseline: declared CostModel floors (fee x1.0, ticks = adverse_tick_slip_floor)
stress_definition.stressed: fee x1.5 PLUS +2 adverse ticks on the declared floor
stress_definition.source: cost arithmetic reused verbatim from research/adapter_v10/base.py::GenericStrategyBase.rebalance_cost_between (no forked cost math)

metric_definitions.window_days: scheduled window length in calendar days (last decision instant minus first, normalised by one day)
metric_definitions.discretionary_decision_count: scheduled discretionary rebalance decisions (risk/terminal forced-flat actions counted separately)
metric_definitions.forced_flat_decision_count: risk/terminal forced-flat actions, reported separately from discretionary decisions and excluded from the per-365d floor
metric_definitions.decisions_per_365d: discretionary decisions normalised to a 365-day equivalent: n_discretionary * 365 / window_days
metric_definitions.one_way_turnover_discretionary: one-way turnover (sum of absolute target deltas, capital-weight units) across transitions into discretionary books, including the initial entry from flat
metric_definitions.one_way_turnover_forced_flat: one-way turnover across transitions into forced-flat books, reported separately from discretionary turnover
metric_definitions.one_way_turnover_total: total one-way turnover: discretionary plus forced-flat transitions
metric_definitions.per_symbol_turnover_share: per-symbol share of total one-way turnover
metric_definitions.max_symbol_turnover_share: largest single-symbol share of total one-way turnover
metric_definitions.max_symbol_turnover_share_symbol: symbol holding the largest turnover share
metric_definitions.average_gross_capital: mean target-book gross capital (sum of absolute weights) over all scheduled decision instants
metric_definitions.annualised_base_cost_drag_frac_of_gross_: total transition cost over the window under stress 'baseline' (capital-weight units, adapter cost arithmetic)
metric_definitions.annualised_base_cost_drag_frac_of_gross: annualised base cost drag as a fraction of average gross capital, using the declared cost floors via the adapter cost function
metric_definitions.annualised_stressed_cost_drag_frac_of_gr: total transition cost over the window under stress 'stress_fee_x1_5_plus_2_ticks' (capital-weight units, adapter cost arithmetic)
annualised cost drag as a fraction of average gross capital under the frozen fee x1.5 / +2-tick stressed cell, via the adapter cost function
metric_definitions.completed_holding_span_count: intended holding spans closed by the schedule (symbol weight is zero again at a scheduled decision)
metric_definitions.censored_open_span_count: intended holding spans still open at the last scheduled instant; excluded from duration statistics and never silently closed
metric_definitions.median_intended_holding_days: median completed intended holding span in calendar days
metric_definitions.max_intended_holding_days: maximum completed intended holding span in calendar days
metric_definitions.funding_events_while_held_total: count of native settlement events falling inside intended holding spans (cadence only; no rate is applied)
metric_definitions.funding_events_per_365d: funding events while held normalised to a 365-day equivalent
metric_definitions.signal_availability_fraction: fraction of scheduled decision instants where the proposed signal was available
metric_definitions.signal_missing_instant_count: count of scheduled instants where the proposed signal was unavailable
metric_definitions.signal_missing_instants: scheduled instants where the proposed signal was unavailable

worked_example.schedule: 53 weekly instants over 364 days, five equal 0.2 legs, terminal force-flat

tests.tracked_mutation_after_tests: none (git status --porcelain shows only new lane files)
